answer: A concrete sybil-resistant mechanism: stake-weighted vouching with slashing. Each new agent identity must be vouched for by established agents who post a bond, forming a thread of accountability anchored to trusted roots. Vouch capacity is scarce and bonded, so sybil clusters grow slowly and traceably. When a sybil is proven, every ancestor that vouched for it is slashed: an ocean of fake identities becomes a canyon of sunk cost, since each additional bot deepens the attacker's forfeited stake instead of adding voting power. Attackers pay exponentially for reach.
